result.topic_en: The top of the page holds a Latin note on the attraction of a finite elliptic cylinder whose density is +1/2 for positive x and -1/2 for negative x. Below are several heavily corrected German drafts of a letter to a colleague returning or forwarding Mr. Stud. Geiler's treatise with remarks, apparently to the editors.

methods.what: Attraction components of a finite elliptic cylinder with antisymmetric density ±1/2, with a case parameter ε for the position of the attracted point, and integration over an angle from 0 to 2π
methods.quote:

negativa cylindri

items.quote: Unde [-...-] attractio cylindri utcumque finiti facile determinatur.
items.english: Hence the attraction of an arbitrarily finite cylinder is easily determined.
